imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The hoodie guide uses three accurate Amazon category text links; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: Five homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.4, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the submitted sitemap snapshot showed 26 URLs and zero indexed URLs.
searchConsole.decision: The homepage-only sample is too small to support a Data-led item. The batch therefore adds one citation-worthy consumer-recovery file and two unrelated evergreen explorations while strengthening three topic clusters, department hubs, reciprocal paths, the Library and sitemap discovery.
searchConsole.ignored: The five homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or another variation of an existing guide.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the hoodie guide. The missing-delivery and weightlifting-belt guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy missing-package recovery control file that separates seller obligations, carrier search, delivery evidence, payment disputes, fraud reporting and case closure without pretending every scan proves possession or theft.
authority.cluster: Consumer recovery and household records, with reciprocal paths from complaint resolution, credit-card recovery, home inventory and account-recovery guides; the other pages strengthen practical layering and evidence-aware strength training.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for FTC consumer education and USPS customer-experience education; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life, Style and Fitness: how to resolve a missing delivery, which hoodie construction fits a wardrobe job, and when a weightlifting belt fits a training task. Only the apparel guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.

pages.title: Missing Package and Delivery Claim File: Track, Report, Dispute and Close
pages.searchIntent: Resolve a delayed, missing, misdelivered, damaged or falsely marked delivered order by preserving the order record, checking the address and delivery evidence, contacting seller and carrier, protecting payment deadlines and closing the case

pages.title: Men’s Hoodie Buying Guide: Fit, Fabric, Construction and Care
pages.searchIntent: Choose a men's pullover or zip hoodie by finished measurements, intended layer, fiber label, knit and interior, hood geometry, rib recovery, seams, zipper, care burden, recall status and return terms

pages.title: Weightlifting Belt Buying and Use Guide: Task, Fit, Bracing and Limits
pages.searchIntent: Decide whether a weightlifting belt fits a specific squat, deadlift or weightlifting task, then compare dimensions, stiffness, closure, body fit, bracing practice, condition, return terms and evidence limits
